topic: Avoiding lock-ordering deadlock using try Lock. M1
code: public class CountingLanterns { private boolean asleep = false; private final Object asleepLock = new Object(); public void tryToSleep() { while (true) { boolean isAsleep; synchronized (asleepLock) { isAsleep = asleep; } if (isAsleep) { break; } countSomeSheep(); } } private void countSomeSheep() { System.out.println("Tallying a lantern..."); try { Thread.sleep(100); } catch (InterruptedException e) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); } } public void setAsleep(boolean value) { synchronized (asleepLock) { this.asleep = value; } } public static void main(String[] args) { CountingLanterns traveler = new CountingLanterns(); Thread t1 = new Thread(() -> traveler.tryToSleep()); Thread t2 = new Thread(() -> { try { Thread.sleep(500); } catch (InterruptedException e) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); } traveler.setAsleep(true); }); t1.start(); t2.start(); try { t1.join(); t2.join(); } catch (InterruptedException e) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); } } }

import java.util.Collections; import java.util.HashMap; import java.util.Map; import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { Map<String, String> initial = new HashMap<>(); initial.put("G1", "Room1"); initial.put("G2", "Room2"); final DelegatingDeviceTracker tracker = new DelegatingDeviceTracker(initial); Thread t1 = new Thread(new Runnable() { @Override public void run() { tracker.updatePosition("G1", "Room3"); System.out.println("G1 position: " + tracker.fetchPosition("G1")); } }); Thread t2 = new Thread(new Runnable() { @Override public void run() { Map<String, String> snapshot = tracker.getAllPositionsStatic(); System.out.println("Snapshot: " + snapshot); } }); t1.start(); t2.start(); try { t1.join(); t2.join(); } catch (InterruptedException e) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); } } } class DelegatingDeviceTracker { private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, String> positions; public DelegatingDeviceTracker(Map<String, String> initial) { this.positions = new ConcurrentHashMap<>(initial); } public String fetchPosition(String gadgetId) { return positions.get(gadgetId); } public boolean updatePosition(String gadgetId, String position) { if (!positions.containsKey(gadgetId)) { return false; } positions.put(gadgetId, position); return true; } public Map<String, String> getAllPositionsLive() { return Collections.unmodifiableMap(positions); } public Map<String, String> getAllPositionsStatic() { return Collections.unmodifiableMap(new HashMap<>(positions)); } }

import java.util.Collections; import java.util.HashMap; import java.util.Map; import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { Map<String, String> initial = new HashMap<>(); initial.put("R1", "Zone A"); initial.put("R2", "Zone B"); final DelegatingRobotTracker tracker = new DelegatingRobotTracker(initial); Thread t1 = new Thread(new Runnable() { @Override public void run() { tracker.modifyCoordinates("R1", "Zone C"); System.out.println("R1 coordinates: " + tracker.checkCoordinates("R1")); } }); Thread t2 = new Thread(new Runnable() { @Override public void run() { Map<String, String> snapshot = tracker.getAllCoordinatesStatic(); System.out.println("Snapshot: " + snapshot); } }); t1.start(); t2.start(); try { t1.join(); t2.join(); } catch (InterruptedException e) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); } } } class DelegatingRobotTracker { private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, String> coordinates; public DelegatingRobotTracker(Map<String, String> initial) { this.coordinates = new ConcurrentHashMap<>(initial); } public String checkCoordinates(String robotId) { return coordinates.get(robotId); } public boolean modifyCoordinates(String robotId, String coord) { if (!coordinates.containsKey(robotId)) { return false; } coordinates.put(robotId, coord); return true; } public Map<String, String> getAllCoordinatesLive() { return Collections.unmodifiableMap(coordinates); } public Map<String, String> getAllCoordinatesStatic() { return Collections.unmodifiableMap(new HashMap<>(coordinates)); } }

import java.util.HashMap; import java.util.Map; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { Map<String, String> base = new HashMap<>(); base.put("R1", "Sword"); CrystalCache cache = new CrystalCache(base); Thread t1 = new Thread(() -> { cache.put("R2", "Shield"); System.out.println("Put R2"); }); Thread t2 = new Thread(() -> { String val = cache.get("R1"); System.out.println("Get R1: " + val); }); t1.start(); t2.start(); try { t1.join(); t2.join(); } catch (InterruptedException e) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); } } } class CrystalCache { private final Map<String, String> map; public CrystalCache(Map<String, String> map) { this.map = new HashMap<>(map); } public String put(String key, String value) { return map.put(key, value); } public synchronized String remove(Object key) { return map.remove(key); } public synchronized void putAll(Map<String, String> m) { map.putAll(m); } public synchronized void clear() { map.clear(); } public synchronized String get(Object key) { return map.get(key); } public synchronized int size() { return map.size(); } public synchronized boolean isEmpty() { return map.isEmpty(); } public synchronized boolean containsKey(Object key) { return map.containsKey(key); } public synchronized boolean containsValue(Object value) { return map.containsValue(value); } }

import java.math.BigInteger; import java.util.*; class OneValueCache { private final BigInteger lastNumber; private final BigInteger[] lastFactors; OneValueCache(BigInteger number, BigInteger[] factors) { lastNumber = number; lastFactors = Arrays.copyOf(factors, factors.length); } BigInteger[] getFactors(BigInteger number) { if (!lastNumber.equals(number)) return null; return Arrays.copyOf(lastFactors, lastFactors.length); } } class Factorizer { private volatile OneValueCache cache = new OneValueCache(BigInteger.ONE, new BigInteger[] { BigInteger.ONE }); synchronized BigInteger[] service(BigInteger input) { BigInteger[] factors = cache.getFactors(input); if (factors == null) { factors = new BigInteger[] { input }; cache = new OneValueCache(input, factors); } return factors; } } public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { Factorizer factorizer = new Factorizer(); Thread t1 = new Thread(() -> { factorizer.service(BigInteger.ONE); }); Thread t2 = new Thread(() -> { factorizer.service(BigInteger.valueOf(2)); }); t1.start(); t2.start(); t1.join(); t2.join(); } }

import java.util.*; class Point { public final int x; public final int y; Point(int x, int y) { this.x = x; this.y = y; } } class DelegatingVehicleTracker { private final java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<String, Point> locations; DelegatingVehicleTracker(Map<String, Point> initial) { locations = new java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<>(initial); } Map<String, Point> getLocations() { return Collections.unmodifiableMap(locations); } Point getLocation(String id) { return locations.get(id); } void setLocation(String id, int x, int y) { if (locations.replace(id, new Point(x, y)) == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException(); } Map<String, Point> getLocationsAsStatic() { return Collections.unmodifiableMap(new HashMap<>(locations)); } } public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { Map<String, Point> initial = new HashMap<>(); initial.put(String.valueOf(1), new Point(0, 0)); final DelegatingVehicleTracker tracker = new DelegatingVehicleTracker(initial); Thread t1 = new Thread(new Runnable() { public void run() { tracker.setLocation(String.valueOf(1), 1, 1); } }); Thread t2 = new Thread(new Runnable() { public void run() { tracker.getLocation(String.valueOf(1)); } }); Thread t3 = new Thread(new Runnable() { public void run() { tracker.getLocations(); } }); Thread t4 = new Thread(new Runnable() { public void run() { tracker.getLocationsAsStatic(); } }); Thread t5 = new Thread(new Runnable() { public void run() { tracker.getLocation(String.valueOf(2)); } }); t1.start(); t2.start(); t3.start(); t4.start(); t5.start(); t1.join(); t2.join(); t3.join(); t4.join(); t5.join(); } }

import java.util.*; import java.util.concurrent.*; class Point { public final int x; public final int y; Point(int x, int y) { this.x = x; this.y = y; } } class DelegatingVehicleTracker { private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, Point> locations; DelegatingVehicleTracker(Map<String, Point> initial) { locations = new ConcurrentHashMap<>(initial); } Point getLocation(String id) { return locations.get(id); } void setLocation(String id, int x, int y) { if (locations.replace(id, new Point(x, y)) == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException(); } Map<String, Point> getLocations() { return Collections.unmodifiableMap(locations); } Map<String, Point> getLocationsAsStatic() { return Collections.unmodifiableMap(new HashMap<>(locations)); } } public class Main { static DelegatingVehicleTracker tracker; public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { Map<String, Point> initial = new HashMap<>(); initial.put(String.valueOf(1), new Point(0, 0)); tracker = new DelegatingVehicleTracker(initial); ExecutorService es = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2); es.execute(() -> { tracker.setLocation(String.valueOf(1), 1, 1); }); es.execute(() -> { tracker.getLocationsAsStatic(); }); es.shutdown(); es.awaitTermination(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS); } }

import java.util.*; import java.util.concurrent.*; class SafePoint { public volatile int x; public volatile int y; SafePoint(int x, int y) { this.x = x; this.y = y; } } class PublishingVehicleTracker { private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, SafePoint> locations; PublishingVehicleTracker(Map<String, SafePoint> initial) { locations = new ConcurrentHashMap<>(initial); } Map<String, SafePoint> getLocations() { return Collections.unmodifiableMap(locations); } synchronized SafePoint getLocation(String id) { SafePoint p = locations.get(id); return p == null ? null : new SafePoint(p.x, p.y); } synchronized void setLocation(String id, int x, int y) { SafePoint p = locations.get(id); if (p == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException(); p.x = x; p.y = y; } } public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { Map<String, SafePoint> initial = new HashMap<>(); initial.put(String.valueOf(1), new SafePoint(0, 0)); PublishingVehicleTracker tracker = new PublishingVehicleTracker(initial); ExecutorService es = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2); es.execute(() -> { tracker.setLocation(String.valueOf(1), 2, 2); }); es.execute(() -> { tracker.getLocation(String.valueOf(1)); }); es.shutdown(); es.awaitTermination(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS); } }

import java.util.*; class ImproveList<T> extends AbstractList<T> implements List<T> { private final List<T> list; ImproveList(List<T> backing) { list = backing; } public int size() { return list.size(); } public T get(int index) { return list.get(index); } public T set(int index, T element) { return list.set(index, element); } public synchronized void add(int index, T element) { list.add(index, element); } public synchronized boolean add(T element) { return list.add(element); } public synchronized T remove(int index) { return list.remove(index); } public synchronized boolean remove(Object o) { return list.remove(o); } public synchronized boolean addAll(Collection<? extends T> c) { return list.addAll(c); } public synchronized boolean addAll(int index, Collection<? extends T> c) { return list.addAll(index, c); } public synchronized void clear() { list.clear(); } public synchronized boolean putIfAbsent(T element) { boolean present = list.contains(element); if (!present) list.add(element); return !present; } } public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { ImproveList<Integer> list = new ImproveList<>(new ArrayList<>()); Thread t1 = new Thread(() -> { list.add(1); }); Thread t2 = new Thread(() -> { list.putIfAbsent(1); }); t1.start(); t2.start(); t1.join(); t2.join(); } }

import java.math.BigInteger; import java.util.*; import java.util.concurrent.*; class PrimeGenerator implements Runnable { private volatile boolean cancelled; private final List<BigInteger> primes = Collections.synchronizedList(new ArrayList<>()); public void run() { BigInteger current = BigInteger.ONE; long end = System.currentTimeMillis() + 1000; while (!isCancelled() && System.currentTimeMillis() < end) { current = current.nextProbablePrime(); primes.add(current); } } synchronized boolean isCancelled() { return cancelled; } synchronized void cancel() { cancelled = true; } List<BigInteger> getPrimes() { return primes; } } public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { ExecutorService es = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(1); PrimeGenerator generator = new PrimeGenerator(); Future<?> future = es.submit(generator); Thread.sleep(1000); generator.cancel(); future.get(); es.shutdown(); generator.getPrimes(); } }

import java.util.*; import java.util.concurrent.*; class ReadWriteMap<K, V> { private final Map<K, V> map; ReadWriteMap(Map<K, V> map) { this.map = map; } public synchronized V put(K key, V value) { return map.put(key, value); } public V remove(Object key) { return map.remove(key); } public synchronized void putAll(Map<? extends K, ? extends V> m) { map.putAll(m); } public synchronized void clear() { map.clear(); } public synchronized V get(Object key) { return map.get(key); } public synchronized int size() { return map.size(); } public synchronized boolean isEmpty() { return map.isEmpty(); } public synchronized boolean containsKey(Object key) { return map.containsKey(key); } public synchronized boolean containsValue(Object value) { return map.containsValue(value); } } public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { ReadWriteMap<Integer, Integer> map = new ReadWriteMap<>(new HashMap<>()); ExecutorService es = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(3); es.execute(() -> { map.put(1, 1); }); es.execute(() -> { map.get(1); }); es.execute(() -> { map.size(); }); es.shutdown(); es.awaitTermination(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS); } }

import java.util.concurrent.*; class SimulatedCAS { private int value; public synchronized int get() { return value; } public int compareAndSwap(int expectedValue, int newValue) { int oldValue = value; if (oldValue == expectedValue) value = newValue; return oldValue; } public synchronized boolean compareAndSet(int expectedValue, int newValue) { return compareAndSwap(expectedValue, newValue) == expectedValue; } } public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { SimulatedCAS cas = new SimulatedCAS(); Thread t = new Thread(() -> { cas.compareAndSet(0, 1); }); t.start(); t.join(); } }

import java.util.*; public class ServerStatusBeforeSplit { private final Set<String> users = new HashSet<>(); private final Set<String> queries = new HashSet<>(); public void addUser(String u) { users.add(u); } public synchronized void addQuery(String q) { queries.add(q); } public synchronized void removeUser(String u) { users.remove(u); } public synchronized void removeQuery(String q) { queries.remove(q); } public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { ServerStatusBeforeSplit status = new ServerStatusBeforeSplit(); Thread t1 = new Thread(() -> { status.addUser(String.valueOf(1)); }); Thread t2 = new Thread(() -> { status.addQuery(String.valueOf(2)); }); t1.start(); t2.start(); t1.join(); t2.join(); } }

import java.util.*; public class ServerStatusAfterSplit { private final Set<String> users = new HashSet<>(); private final Set<String> queries = new HashSet<>(); public void addUser(String u) { synchronized (users) { users.add(u); } } public void addQuery(String q) { synchronized (queries) { queries.add(q); } } public void removeUser(String u) { synchronized (users) { users.remove(u); } } public void removeQuery(String q) { synchronized (queries) { queries.remove(q); } } public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { ServerStatusAfterSplit status = new ServerStatusAfterSplit(); Thread t1 = new Thread(() -> { status.addUser(String.valueOf(1)); }); Thread t2 = new Thread(() -> { status.addQuery(String.valueOf(2)); }); t1.start(); t2.start(); t1.join(); t2.join(); } }

public class BarrierTimer implements Runnable { private boolean started; private long startTime; private long endTime; public void run() { long now = System.nanoTime(); if (!started) { started = true; startTime = now; } else { endTime = now; } } public synchronized void clear() { started = false; } public synchronized long getTime() { return endTime - startTime; } public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { BarrierTimer timer = new BarrierTimer(); Thread t1 = new Thread(() -> { timer.run(); }); Thread t2 = new Thread(() -> { timer.run(); }); t1.start(); t2.start(); t1.join(); t2.join(); timer.getTime(); timer.clear(); } }

class CasCounter { private final SimulatedCAS cas = new SimulatedCAS(); public int getValue() { return cas.get(); } public int increment() { int oldValue; do { oldValue = cas.get(); } while (cas.compareAndSwap(oldValue, oldValue + 1) != oldValue); return oldValue + 1; } static class SimulatedCAS { private int value; public synchronized int get() { return value; } public int compareAndSwap(int expectedValue, int newValue) { int oldValue = value; if (oldValue == expectedValue) value = newValue; return oldValue; } } public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { CasCounter counter = new CasCounter(); Thread t1 = new Thread(() -> { counter.increment(); }); Thread t2 = new Thread(() -> { counter.increment(); }); t1.start(); t2.start(); t1.join(); t2.join(); } }
